summary: CVR Partners, LP filed Form 8-K reporting that Mark A. Pytosh stepped down as President and CEO of CVR Energy and as President and CEO of CVR GP, the general partner of CVR Partners. He also left the boards of both entities. A separation agreement provides a $3,000,000 payment ($1.5M within 15 days after release becomes irrevocable, $1.5M after 9 months). Pytosh remains bound by confidentiality, non-competition (reduced to 9 months), and non-solicitation provisions. The abrupt departure of both CEO and board roles at the parent and GP levels signals a significant governance shift; watch for succession announcements and potential strategic changes at CVR Partners.
